title: fix(metadata-protocol,runtime): a seed load that throws part-way still reports landed ids for the datasets that finished

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBJoqimjkfUcABKduhN9k5hC)_

Fixes #30429

Clause-②: yes (widening: a thrown load's receipt carries `landed` for the datasets that finished, where it carried none)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none owed — no skill, eval or doc teaches `seedApplied`, `landedIds` or `SeedLoadPartialWrites` (`git grep -n "seedApplied\|landedIds\|SeedLoadPartialWrites" -- skills content/docs ':!content/docs/references' ':!content/docs/releases'`: 0 hits; control `git grep -c "publish" -- skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`: 5); the generated `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` is regenerated here. The skills lane is paused; nothing is owed to it from this PR.
Prior rulings read: seedapplied,seedloadpartialwrites,landed → 16 hits; ADR-0038 Decision §4, ADR-0056 D10, ADR-0058 D7, ADR-0060 D5, ADR-0061 D2, ADR-0076 D10, ADR-0090 D10, ADR-0093 D9, ADR-0094 D5; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：种子加载中途抛错时，发布回执 `seedApplied` 现在也带 `landed`，列出抛错前已经跑完的数据集落下的行 id（同一个投影、同样分 `inserted`/`matched` 两张表、同样 200 上限）；抛错的那个数据集不列出。运行时的兜底种子应用走同一读取与投影。
- 为什么改：#30348 之后，加载一旦中途失败，回执只有条数没有 id，cloud 的「清理示例数据」拿不到前面已落库数据集的行，这些示例行就清不掉。
- 风险与回滚：只在失败回执上多给一个已有的可选字段；成功路径不变。`landed` 缺席的含义收窄为"没有运行加载"，抛错前一个数据集都没跑完时给 `[]`。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` 的 `SeedLoadPartialWrites.finished` 与 `notePartialWrites`；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts` 的 catch；`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 兜底 catch。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/publish-seed-receipt-landed-ids.test.ts`，预期 10 例全绿，其中"load that threw"一例的 `landed` 只含先跑完的对象。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`seed-loader.ts`): `SeedLoadPartialWrites.finished`.** `notePartialWrites` snapshots the finished datasets' `{ object, landedIds, insertedIds }`, in load order, off the results it already keeps (`loadProgress.finished`). Nothing new is tracked; the ids are the ones each finished dataset's returned result carries. Empty when the throw came before any dataset finished.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`protocol-publish-batch.ts`): `applySeedBodies`' catch** adds `landed: seedAppliedLanded(written.finished)` whenever a partial-writes reading exists. Same projection as the returned path (`seedAppliedLanded`), so the same two lists, the same per-object fold and the same 200 cap. No reading (the request parse refused, or the loader module never loaded) leaves `landed` absent.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`index.ts`)**: `seedLoadPartialWrites` and `SeedLoadPartialWrites` are exported from the package root, so the runtime fallback reads the same record.
- **`@objectstack/runtime` (`domains/packages.ts`)**: the route-level fallback seed apply's catch reads `seedLoadPartialWrites(e)` and reports the same `landed`. It had the same thrown path (`applyPublishedSeeds` → `loader.load` throws → catch with `success: false`, `error`).
- **`@objectstack/spec` (`api/protocol.zod.ts`)**: the shared `seedApplied.landed` description (both publish responses) and the `PublishMetaItemResponseSchema` docblock now say what `landed` covers on a thrown load (the datasets that finished; not the one that threw) and when it is still absent (no load ran, or a producer that reports no ids). Schema shape unchanged. `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` regenerated.
- `.changeset/30429-seed-receipt-landed-on-throw.md`: spec minor, metadata-protocol minor, runtime patch, with a "Supersedes, in the same release" paragraph for the sentence in the unreleased `.changeset/30348-seed-receipt-landed-ids.md` that this makes false.

### The dataset that threw: omitted, and why

Measured at `seed-loader.ts`: the dataset that throws can have landed rows before the throw. Its batched inserts flush every `insertBatchSize` records (`flushPendingInserts`), so earlier batches are written, and a throw can come after a row was written (the seed-file settle, pinned in `seed-loader-seed-files.test.ts`: `pw_doc`'s D1 is in the store when the storage service throws). Those rows are in `inserted` / `updated` and the object is named in `error`, but they are **not listed** in `landed`:

- Its ids are only partly known when it throws. A batched insert whose response was lost may have committed rows whose ids never came back; the loader re-reads by key on its retry for exactly that reason. A list of the ids it did see would read as complete while missing rows, which is the one thing a reader of the ids cannot check.
- A finished dataset's list is complete, so "the datasets that finished" is a line a reader can rely on. This is the card's default.

A reader that wants to know whether unlisted rows exist compares `inserted` with the listed `inserted.total`s; `error` names the object.

### What `landed` answers now

| Receipt | `landed` |
| --- | --- |
| load returned | every dataset (unchanged) |
| load threw after some datasets finished | those datasets only |
| load threw before any dataset finished | `[]` (the loader ran; nothing finished) |
| no load ran (seed bodies refused at parse, no readable bodies) | absent |

## Why

#30348 (PR #30427) put the ids on the receipt, but only on the returned-load path; its contract review named the gap at `applySeedBodies`' catch. After a partial publish cloud's "clear sample data" had no ids for the datasets that did land, so those sample rows could never be cleared by id.

## Verification

Head `4c02bddf8`, under `os-verify-lock`, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 316 passed, 4 skipped (320), Tests 22425 passed, 26 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 551 passed (551), Tests 10989 passed. `typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 543 passed (543), Tests 8647 passed, 19 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 815 passed (815), Tests 25622 passed, 1 todo. `typecheck` exit 0.
- Pins:
  - `packages/objectql/src/publish-seed-receipt-landed-ids.test.ts` (real protocol, real ObjectQL engine, real loader over an in-memory driver; ids read back from the engine). The old pin "a load that threw reports no ids" is replaced by: a good seed (with a customer's pre-existing row its key matches) lands, a later seed naming a missing object throws; the receipt lists the good seed's created id under `inserted` and the customer's row under `matched`, has no entry for the object that threw, and `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema` keeps it. Plus: a load that throws before any seed finished reports `landed: []`, not absent.
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-seed-apply-landed-thrown.test.ts` (new, the fallback door with the real `SeedLoaderService`): positive control on a returned load; a second dataset's existing-row read throws after the first dataset wrote, and the receipt lists the first; a failure before any load ran leaves `landed` absent.
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader-seed-files.test.ts`: `seedLoadPartialWrites` now carries `finished` with the finished dataset's store ids, and leaves out the dataset that threw although its row D1 was written; a throw before any dataset reads `finished: []`.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (two mutations, each restored by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs to the HEAD blob)</summary>

The objectql and runtime pins resolve `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` from `dist`, so each mutation was rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirmed the marker in 2 built files before reading a result. Directions predicted before running.

1. The loader carries no finished ids (`finished: finished.map(...)` → `finished: (globalThis as any).ABL30429A ?? []`, blob `a7986c958ece` → `c3a35b1b3aa0`): objectql landed pins **1 failed | 9 passed** (the thrown-after-finish case; the before-any-finished `[]` case holds either way), runtime fallback **1 failed | 2 passed**, `seedLoadPartialWrites` unit **1 failed | 2 passed**. Restored: blob == HEAD.
2. The catch drops `landed` (`...(written ? { landed: ... } : {})` → `...((globalThis as any).ABL30429B ?? {})`, blob `eccb3c495621` → `cb59f9935201`): objectql landed pins **2 failed | 8 passed** (both thrown cases). Restored: blob == HEAD.

Restore leg: rebuilt, `--absent` preflight green for both markers, `git diff HEAD` empty, the three files back to 10/10, 3/3, 3/3. A first attempt planted the markers as comments, which the build strips; the preflight refused it (marker absent from dist) before any test ran, and it is discarded.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran gates-ran.list`: "105 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 105 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)", exit 0. Every line `exit 0`.
- The serial pass ran at `be4d35b5` (the implementation commit); `4c02bddf8` adds only the changeset's "Supersedes" paragraph, and the changeset gates (`check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`) plus `check:generated` and `check:nul-bytes` were re-run on `4c02bddf8`, exit 0.
- Three families exited 3 (prerequisite) on the first pass and were re-run green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (its pinned fixture commit fetched), `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (after a full `turbo run build`, 119/119).
- `Prior rulings read` is from `node scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 30429 --terms seedApplied,SeedLoadPartialWrites,landed`. ADR-0038 Decision §4 (L3 probes attach to the publish response "like `seedApplied`") does not rule on the receipt's ids; the other hits match the word "landed" in unrelated decisions. The card's thread holds no ruling.
- `check-changeset-no-major` with this body as the event: exit 0 on `Metadata-protocol: semantic` (spec and metadata-protocol `minor`). Controls: `none` exits 1 (the `minor` entries are unaccounted for); `added` also exits 0, so the gate checks the level, not the kind. The kind is `semantic` by reading: no schema key is added or removed (the schema shape is byte-identical; only the description moves), and an existing key's absence changes meaning on a thrown load, from "not reported" to "no load ran".
- No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm: no full dogfood run. CI owns the rest of the farm.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The runtime fallback's thrown receipt carries `success`, `error` and now `landed`, but still no `inserted` / `updated` counts, although `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.seedApplied` declares both required. Pre-existing (the fallback's catch never read the partial counts); not changed here. carrier: none.
- The seed-ownership claim (`claim-seed-ownership.ts`, `seed-settlement.ts`) still reads `landedIds`: out of scope per the card.
